simple.meaning: זָנוּן (zânûwn) is a Hebrew word meaning “adultery ; figuratively, idolatry.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: זָנוּן (H2183) appears 12 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 38:24, with occurrences in Genesis, 2 Kings, Ezekiel, Hosea, Nahum.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זָנוּן (H2183) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in זָנוּן (H2183) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: זָנוּן (zânûwn) / H2183 is traced through Genesis 38:24, 2 Kings 9:22, Ezekiel 23:11, Ezekiel 23:29 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

majorEvents.evidenceText: When Yahweh spoke at first by Hosea, Yahweh said to Hosea, “Go, take for yourself a wife of prostitution and children of unfaithfulness; for the land commits great adultery, forsaking Yahweh.”

timeline.evidenceText: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.”
When Joram saw Jehu, he said, “Is it peace, Jehu?”
“Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more depraved than the prostitution of her sister.

They will deal with you in hatred, and will take away all your labor, and will leave you naked and bare. The nakedness of your prostitution will be uncovered, both your lewdness and your prostitution.

Indeed, on her children I will have no mercy;
Therefore behold,‡ “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. I will hedge up your way with thorns,
My people consult with their wooden idol,
Their deeds won’t allow them to turn to their God;
because of the multitude of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the mistress of witchcraft, who sells nations through her prostitution, and families through her witchcraft.
